about.overview: Our experience, knowledge, and understanding in all fields of car modification enables us to offer a wide range of specialised services for any type of vehicle. Our large workshop and Dyno Dyanmics 4WD dyno, lets us cater for any job big or small. Full engine rebuilds, and fabrication, to complete rewiring, installation and tuning of any after market ECU whether it be piston or rotary application.
